text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرًۭا وَلَآ أَعْصِى لَكَ أَمْرًۭا

words.gloss_range: completed report of Musa speaking; locally opens a direct quoted promise rather than a command or question
words.root_gloss_range: root range of saying, declaration, speech, and inner opinion made outward; local form selects a completed speech act that launches the pledge
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) turns the ayah into Musa's reply: a completed speech event opens a full quoted promise, with Musa recoverable from the dialogue rather than renamed. The speech verb makes the promise itself the payload, so patience and non-disobedience become publicly accountable words. In the episode's repeated speech-chain (18:67, 18:69, 18:72, 18:75, 18:78), this is the promise-turn that later questions and corrections will test.

topics.headline: direct promise speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa's answer is framed as one completed direct-speech pledge, not as narration about a private intention.
topics.reason: The perfect 3ms speech verb governs the full quoted content from the future-finding promise through the closing command-domain.

topics.headline: spoken accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa does not merely intend patience; he articulates it as a saying that can later be measured against his conduct.
topics.reason: The speech-root rows fit the local direct-speech frame: inner commitment is externalized in words before the journey resumes.

topics.headline: dialogue spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this word places the ayah inside an escalating dialogue sequence whose later speech turns revisit the promise.
topics.reason: The same-surah qāla sequence is concrete and locally relevant; it shows this utterance as one turn in the Musa-al-Khidr exchange.

words.gloss_range: future finding/perceiving of Musa with an attached first-person object; locally means al-Khidr will find Musa patient
words.root_gloss_range: local evidence selects experiential finding or perceiving a quality; broader root-family associations are only useful where they support that verification frame
words.prose: {{ar:سَتَجِدُنِي}} ({{tr:satajidunī}}) puts Musa himself inside al-Khidr's future assessment: the second-person subject will find the first-person object, and the promised quality arrives only after the divine-will insertion. The verb therefore makes patience something to be verified by experience, not certified by Musa's assertion alone. Its formulaic pressure links the pledge with 37:102, while the same-surah finding field contrasts absence and discovery (18:17, 18:53, 18:58).

topics.headline: future verification by al-Khidr
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa places his promised patience under al-Khidr's coming perception rather than under his own self-certification.
topics.reason: The future-marked imperfect has al-Khidr as the second-person subject and Musa as the attached object, so the CRITICAL verification claims are grammatically supported.

topics.headline: experiential finding of a quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that finding here is evaluative and experiential: the quality to be found is Musa's patience.
topics.reason: The object-plus-complement frame supports finding someone to be a quality, not merely locating a person.

topics.headline: conditional delay before the quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise cannot move straight from future finding to patience; divine contingency interrupts before the quality is named.
topics.reason: The conditional clause is syntactically inserted between the future finding verb and the final accusative quality.

topics.headline: formula and finding echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a concrete echo with 37:102 and a same-surah finding contrast in which what can or cannot be found becomes a test.
topics.reason: The cited references are concrete and the echo supports the local promise-before-trial frame without controlling the parse.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle introducing uncertain contingency; locally scopes the first pledge through divine willing
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) inserts contingency into the middle of the first pledge. It makes the surrounding claim dependent on divine willing rather than certain in itself, and its position between future finding and the promised quality makes the interruption felt in the syntax. The particle answers al-Khidr's capacity warning by admitting that endurance depends on more than Musa's resolve.

topics.headline: uncertain condition over the pledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first promise is genuinely conditional, not an unqualified guarantee of patience.
topics.reason: The particle opens the protasis attached to the future-finding apodosis, and the input explicitly contrasts this contingency with a certainty particle.

topics.headline: parenthetical interruption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that theology interrupts grammar: the condition stands between the verb and the quality it promises.
topics.reason: The conditional clause is nested inside the quoted promise and interrupts the verb-complement flow.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb of willing inside the conditional formula; locally makes divine volition the condition for the promised outcome
words.root_gloss_range: root range of willing, wishing, and relation to thinghood; local form selects the act of divine willing, with thinghood pressure only as qualified background
words.prose: {{ar:شَاءَ}} ({{tr:shā'a}}) is the verbal center of the inserted condition: Musa's future patience is routed through an act of divine willing. The perfect form inside the conditional gives the formula compact force while keeping the result future and unmanifest. The formula belongs to a deferred-certainty pattern also heard in 37:102 and 2:70, while the later human-will contrast in 18:77 keeps divine willing distinct from interpersonal reproach. The root's link with thinghood is useful only as a narrowed pressure: patience remains the promised quality, but it is treated as something actual only under God's will.

topics.headline: divine volitional condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the controlling condition is not generic possibility but God's act of willing.
topics.reason: The verb governs the explicit divine subject and carries the local semantics of will or volition.

topics.headline: perfect parenthetical pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act of willing is placed as the pivot of the parenthesis interrupting Musa's own claim.
topics.reason: The perfect verb sits inside the conditional protasis and structurally occupies the center of the interruption.

topics.headline: willing-to-thinghood pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root background makes patience feel like a possible thing actualized by divine will, while local syntax keeps the selected sense as willing.
topics.reason: The root-family link to thinghood can color the condition, but the local surface is the perfect verb of willing and does not select a noun sense.

topics.headline: formula and will echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this formula belongs to a wider Quranic pattern of deferred certainty, with 37:102 and 2:70 as concrete parallels and 18:77 as a later human-will contrast.
topics.reason: The intertext rows provide concrete references and support a formulaic comparison without replacing the local parse.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as explicit nominative subject of the will verb; locally names the agent who conditions Musa's promise
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field of worship, dependence, and absolute reference; derivational disputes remain backgrounded while the local use is the proper name
words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) completes the condition by naming the agent of willing explicitly. The proper name stands between future finding and the promised state, so Musa's patience passes through named divine agency before it can be claimed. The divine name also keeps dependence in view: Musa's pledge is not self-grounded but rests on the named one whose will conditions the outcome. Its formulaic and collocational force ties the ayah's human pledge to divine will and to the closing command-domain, with the obedience contrast in 18:50 and the patience-formula parallel in 37:102 in the background.

topics.headline: named divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condition is anchored in the named divine subject, not left as an abstract fate or unnamed force.
topics.reason: The proper noun is nominative subject of the will verb and is explicitly retained in the formula.

topics.headline: center of the promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name sits syntactically between Musa's future verification and the patience he claims.
topics.reason: The subject closes the conditional parenthesis immediately before the promised quality appears.

topics.headline: dependence-name background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a dependence pressure around the divine name, while the local grammar still uses it simply as the proper subject of willing.
topics.reason: The derivational and semantic background is relevant to dependence in the promise, but it should not override the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: divine-name formula links
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named divine subject binds the promise formula to command and obedience fields, including the contrast with 18:50 and the parallel with 37:102.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows are concrete and locally relevant because God's will precedes the ayah's final command-domain.

words.gloss_range: accusative active participle naming the patient state or quality al-Khidr will find in Musa
words.root_gloss_range: root range of patience, endurance, restraint, and binding; local form selects a singular active participial quality with restraint pressure active as qualified imagery
words.prose: {{ar:صَابِرًا}} ({{tr:ṣābiran}}) finally names the quality delayed by the divine-will parenthesis: Musa is to be found patient, either as his circumstantial state or as the predicate discovered in him. The active participle makes patience a standing quality rather than a single act, yet its singular indefiniteness keeps it as Musa's exposed personal claim rather than membership in a class. The word directly answers al-Khidr's endurance challenge in 18:68 and becomes the promise-node that later returns to patience will test; its indefinite -an cadence is later matched by the ayah's final command-domain. The root's binding and bitter-endurance pressures sharpen the payoff: he is promising self-restraint under acts he will find hard to bear.

topics.headline: found patient quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience is the delayed quality al-Khidr will find in Musa, not a loose adverbial aside.
topics.reason: The accusative form is licensed as ḥāl or second object after the future finding verb, both preserving the same local payoff.

topics.headline: participial personal claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa claims a singular discoverable quality, not an abstract capacity or a settled class identity.
topics.reason: The surface is an indefinite singular active participle, contrasting with gerund and plural-class alternatives.

topics.headline: binding endurance pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices patience as active self-binding under difficulty, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as patient endurance.
topics.reason: The root imagery of binding and bitter endurance sharpens the quality, but the local word remains the active participle for being patient.

topics.headline: episode patience thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa's promise directly answers the warning in 18:68 and becomes the standard tested by later returns to patience.
topics.reason: The same-surah and cross-surah rows give concrete references and preserve the challenge-promise-test arc.

topics.headline: tanwin cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sound of the positive promise will be matched by the ayah's final command-domain.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is locally tied to the second indefinite accusative at the end of the ayah.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the positive patience pledge to the negative non-disobedience pledge
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not merely add another clause; it binds two commitments into one speech act. The first half promises a quality, patience, and the second half promises conduct, non-disobedience. The attachment to the following negation makes the turn compact: the ayah pivots from what Musa will be found to be to what he says he will not do.

topics.headline: twin pledge coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience and non-disobedience are cumulative commitments, not separate alternatives.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the positive and negative halves of Musa's quoted promise.

topics.headline: quality-to-conduct pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from an inward patient state to outward behavior under al-Khidr's authority.
topics.reason: The proclitic joins to the negation and opens the second pledge as a continuation of the first.

words.gloss_range: plain negation particle governing Musa's future or ongoing non-disobedience; locally not the emphatic impossibility negation used in 18:67
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the second pledge with negation, but not with the emphatic verdict used in al-Khidr's earlier warning (18:67). That difference matters: Musa denies that he will disobey, while the prior challenge questioned whether he can endure. The particle governs the whole behavioral pledge through the final object, so the negation covers disobeying al-Khidr in any command or matter.

topics.headline: moderate negation versus verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mismatch between Musa's promised intent and al-Khidr's earlier verdict about capacity (18:67).
topics.reason: The input distinguishes plain negation of the imperfect from the emphatic future negation in 18:67, supporting the intent-versus-capacity contrast.

topics.headline: negation scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small particle controls the whole second pledge, from the verb through the personal dative and final command-domain.
topics.reason: The negation applies to the disobedience action, not to the existence of a command, and the clause boundary keeps it coordinated with the first pledge.

words.gloss_range: first-person imperfect verb negated by lā; locally means Musa will not disobey, resist, or oppose al-Khidr with respect to the command-domain
words.root_gloss_range: root range of disobedience, resistance, rebellion, and fracture imagery; local form selects non-disobedience with fracture/resistance pressure qualified by the dative and object
words.prose: {{ar:أَعْصِي}} ({{tr:aʿṣī}}) is the action-pivot of the second pledge: Musa says that he will not be the acting subject of disobedience. With the personal dative and the closing object, the verb makes obedience relational rather than abstract. Its root field allows resistance, opposition, and fracture imagery to survive as narrowed pressure, so the promise is not merely rule-compliance; it is a pledge not to break from al-Khidr's authority as the journey tests him.

topics.headline: negated first-person pledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa places his own future conduct under negation: he himself promises not to become the disobeying subject.
topics.reason: The finite imperfect is first-person, negated, and future-oriented in the quoted pledge.

topics.headline: relational disobedience frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb binds person and command-domain together: non-disobedience is directed toward al-Khidr and his command or affair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the dative complement and explicit object, exactly matching the CRITICAL rows about the verb organizing the second pledge.

topics.headline: resistance and fracture pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disobedience carries the feel of resisting or breaking a relation, while local syntax keeps the selected sense tied to non-disobedience.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports disobedience, resistance, and fracture imagery, but these remain semantic pressure under the local negated verb rather than a separate concrete action.

topics.headline: foreshadowed test of obedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices dramatic pressure: the denial of disobedience answers the capacity warning in 18:67 and anticipates the later accusation in 18:76.
topics.reason: The referenced contrasts are concrete and central to the episode's test of Musa's pledge.

words.gloss_range: preposition with second-person suffix marking al-Khidr as the personal authority with respect to whom disobedience would occur
words.prose: {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}) personalizes the second pledge. The wording does not say simply that Musa will avoid disobedience, nor does it fold the command into a possessive; it marks al-Khidr as the person toward whom compliance is owed while leaving the final command-domain open. The same addressee continues from the future-finding promise into this obedience pledge and is operationalized by the conditions stated in 18:70.

topics.headline: personal dative authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obedience is directed toward al-Khidr as a person, while the command or matter remains an open object.
topics.reason: The prepositional suffix is the complement of the disobedience verb and marks the affected authority figure, not possession of the following noun.

topics.headline: addressee continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same al-Khidr who will find Musa patient is the authority Musa now pledges not to disobey, with 18:70 giving the practical conditions.
topics.reason: The suffix refers to the servant addressed throughout the pledge, and the next ayah concretely specifies the obedience relation.

topics.headline: bridge to command-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word sitting between disobedience and the final object, inserting personal authority before the command-domain closes.
topics.reason: The word order places the dative between the negated verb and final object, preserving the person-to-matter movement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative object closing the pledge; locally covers any command, matter, affair, or course under al-Khidr's authority
words.root_gloss_range: root range of command, affair, matter, directive, and event-domain; local singular indefinite keeps command and affair senses live together

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: echo phrase from 18:71 used as a nearby contrast to the open command-domain in 18:69

words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرَاً}} ({{tr:amran}}) closes the ayah by giving the negated verb its domain. Its singular indefiniteness makes Musa's pledge broad: not any command, matter, or course of affairs is to be resisted. The word's command-affair polysemy is the payoff, because the next narrative will test Musa not only against spoken instructions but against events he cannot yet interpret. Ending on this open noun leaves the promise suspended over 18:71, where his first protest calls the act {{ar:شَيْئًا إِمْرًا}} ({{tr:shayʾan imran}}), turning the broad pledge into an immediate verbal echo.

topics.headline: blanket indefinite object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is maximally exposed: the object is not one specified order but any command or matter whatsoever.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite noun is the explicit object of the negated disobedience verb, and the tanwīn broadens the pledge-domain.

topics.headline: command-affair polysemy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Musa pledges submission to both directives and the unfolding affair, which is exactly where the later test will hurt.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports both command and affair senses, and the local narrative requires both because Musa will object to events as well as conditions.

topics.headline: compressed obedience construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final object completes a marked construction binding Musa's action, al-Khidr's person, and the open command-domain.
topics.reason: The phrase combines negated disobedience, a personal dative, and an explicit object rather than using a bare obedience verb.

topics.headline: echoed closing domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on the open domain that 18:71 immediately reopens, with broader patience-command resonance including 37:102.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete references, and the final position makes the noun the heard endpoint of the pledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ستجدني إن شاء الله صابرا: future finding, divine condition, and the patient-state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The claim hands verification to the addressee: patience is a future state to be encountered in conduct, while its realization is conditioned on divine willing rather than secured by the speaker's confidence.

activation_trace.role: Finding as encountering an object makes the addressee, not the speaker, the verifier of the promised state.
Willing tied to the thing makes divine agency the condition under which the forecast becomes actual.
Self-restraint from agitation supplies the conduct that is to become observable.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply promises to be patient.
changed_reading.after: The speaker offers a contingent prediction: in future conduct the addressee will have to find him restraining himself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صابرا ولا أعصي لك أمرا: a positive state coordinated with negated rebellion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Patience and obedience form two controls: inwardly hold the self, and outwardly do not exit the addressee's directive. The dative لك makes the discipline relational rather than an abstract virtue.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self supplies the inward restraint side of the discipline.
Exiting obedience supplies the boundary that the negation bars the learner from crossing.
A request carrying obligation supplies the external directive to which restraint must answer.

changed_reading.before: Patience and obedience are two generic virtues.
changed_reading.after: The learner proposes a coupled discipline: regulate inner reaction so that conduct remains inside the guide's directive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أمرا, indefinite after negation, with branch space for both directive and affair.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pledge can range across not disobeying a demand and not acting rebelliously in any affair belonging to the guide; the wording can bind the learner more broadly than one explicit command token.

activation_trace.role: Affair or state broadens the object of non-opposition to whatever case unfolds under the guide.
Demand and obligation preserve the narrower reading of compliance with an issued instruction.

changed_reading.before: I will obey each explicit command you issue.
changed_reading.after: I bind myself both to your directives and, more broadly, against oppositional conduct in any affair entrusted to your guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent challenge locates failure in incomplete access to an event's interior; the following rule operationalizes patience as continuing to follow while withholding questions until the guide originates an account. Obedience thus becomes a temporal-epistemic procedure, not silent approval.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self anchors the procedure in the focus promise rather than in context alone.
Not exiting obedience supplies the focus boundary that the later procedure specifies.
Following behind supplies the continuing relation within which patience must operate.
Capacity and endurance make the guide's prediction a claim about what the learner can sustain.
Complete cognitive enclosure supplies the knowledge the learner presently lacks.
Knowledge of an affair's interior identifies what immediate surface judgment cannot reach.
Questioning as a request is the impulse placed under temporal restraint.
An account newly produced as report marks the authorized moment when withheld inquiry may receive speech.

structural_cues: 18:67-70 runs prediction, epistemic reason, pledge, then a no-question-until-disclosure rule.
The rule delays speech rather than forbidding understanding permanently.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incapacity, incomplete encompassing knowledge, following, suspended questioning, and later-originated report; I infer that these clauses define the practical content of صبر and عدم العصيان. A live alternative is that they are separate etiquette rules rather than a gloss on patience.

changed_reading.before: Patience means tolerating hardship and obeying commands.
changed_reading.after: Here patience means remaining in the learning relation while suspending interrogative judgment until an event's hidden account is initiated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledged object أمر is immediately redescribed through its own branch range: an apparently monstrous affair, the learner's burdened affair, and finally action denied as arising from the guide's own affair or initiative. Obedience is tested precisely where a directive and an alarming state no longer look morally compatible.

activation_trace.role: Departure from obedience anchors the risk that the later semantic pressure exposes.
Demand and obligation establish the command-side sense in the pledge.
A grave, shocking affair turns the pledged noun into Moses's adverse classification of the first act.
Affair or condition makes Moses ask that his own case not be loaded with difficulty.
The guide's denial that the acts arose from his own affair relocates their source beyond private initiative.

structural_cues: The same root moves from 18:69 command, to 18:71 shocking affair, to 18:73 personal case, to 18:82 denied self-origin.
The final occurrence arrives only after all three explanations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated root with command, grave-affair, personal-affair, and denied-self-origin branches; I infer that this recurrence pressures the learner's original pledge by making the commanded field look objectionable before its source is known. The live alternative is ordinary contextual polysemy without deliberate semantic linkage.

changed_reading.before: I will not violate any instruction you give.
changed_reading.after: I will not let an affair that appears monstrous become sufficient grounds to exit your instruction before the action's source and outcome are disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two shocking interventions provoke immediate objections, each followed by a refrain about capacity for patience. The learner then makes one more question terminate companionship; separation and retrospective outcome expose the focus claim as a staged, falsifiable self-prediction rather than a successful vow.

activation_trace.role: Future finding makes subsequent conduct the evidence by which the claim is tested.
Self-restraint supplies the promised capacity whose failure can become visible.
Piercing the vessel supplies the first perceptual shock that draws out an objection.
The repeated restraint branch explicitly scores the first objection against the predicted incapacity.
Taking life supplies a stronger second shock under which suspended judgment fails again.
Questioning becomes the learner's own measurable termination condition.
Companionship and continued attachment are made the stake lost by another breach.
Separation realizes the consequence that converts the pledge into a failed threshold.
Return to outcome delays intelligibility until after the companionship test has ended.

structural_cues: The refrain after the first two objections repeats the prediction of incapacity.
18:76 makes another question self-terminate companionship; 18:78 executes the separation before explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escalating shocks, repeated scoring language, a self-set question threshold, separation, and delayed outcomes; I infer a staged test of the focus forecast. An alternative is that the sequence concerns ordinary forgetfulness and moral protest, not a designed falsification procedure.

changed_reading.before: You will discover that my patience is a stable trait.
changed_reading.after: You will test a contingent forecast in escalating cases; the objections falsify its unqualified form, and only afterward does outcome knowledge explain why restraint was demanded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives the learner's future state to divine willing. Later the learner attributes a wage-option to the guide's willing; the explanations distribute I intended, we intended, and your Lord intended, then deny that the acts arose from the guide's own affair. The contingency becomes an agency grammar: visible first-person action need not be self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Divine willing conditions whether the learner's proposed future state comes into being.
The divine name identifies the will-holder invoked in the condition.
The learner's if-you-willed assigns an unrealized payment choice to the guide's agency.
First-person singular intention presents the vessel intervention at the guide's visible agency level.
First-person plural intention shifts the replacement act away from a simply solitary agent.
The Lord's intention explicitly locates the wall's delayed benefit at the divine level.
The guide's enacted work remains visibly his even as its originating authority is qualified.
Denial of action from the guide's own affair prevents visible execution from collapsing into private origin.

structural_cues: Agency wording progresses from focus إن شاء الله to 18:77 لو شئت and then singular, plural, and divine intention.
18:82 juxtaposes I did it with not from my own affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of will and intention subjects plus a final distinction between doing and self-origin; I infer that the focus condition opens a sustained inquiry into layered agency. The live alternative is rhetorical variation among independently motivated speakers rather than a hierarchy of agency.

changed_reading.before: God willing is a pious qualification attached to a promise.
changed_reading.after: God willing anticipates the episode's central agency distinction: a person can perform and intend at the visible level while realization and originating command remain beyond that person's private will.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pair first find a servant whose decisive knowledge is not visible, and later find a wall whose stored benefit is hidden. These encounters strengthen ستجدني as an evidentiary verb: what someone or something is cannot be certified at first sight but emerges through enacted disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The addressee's future encounter with the learner anchors truth in what conduct will disclose.
Finding the servant begins a pattern in which encounter precedes access to the found object's decisive interior.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the servant's initially concealed differentiating capacity.
Finding the wall repeats encounter before explanation and hidden outcome.
The raised wall supplies a visible object whose actual function is not yet available to the observer.
Stored protected wealth supplies the hidden value behind the wall's misleading surface.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the delayed disclosure toward which the wall episode is ordered.

structural_cues: و ج د frames the servant encounter before the pledge and recurs at the wall before its hidden purpose is explained.
Both found entities exceed their immediately visible description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated finding around agents and objects with concealed capacities; I infer that this pattern sharpens ستجدني into verification by unfolding encounter. The alternative is ordinary narrative repetition with no special force for the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: You will observe that I possess patience.
changed_reading.after: You will only discover what kind of learner I am through events, just as the found servant and found wall disclose more than their first appearance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material ص ب ر branches rather than translating صابرا by them. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the final wall's collapse, stabilization, and preservation of hidden wealth until maturity. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy for patience as holding structure, not a lexical claim that صابرا means wall.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صابرًا through ص ب ر B004-B005: containing sides and thick stone.

activation_trace.role: Sides and boundaries supply a containing edge as a material image for restraint.
Thick stone supplies structural endurance for the exploratory wall analogy.
The raised wall gives the analogy its concrete containing structure.
Unbinding and undoing a construction supplies the imminent failure that restraint must delay.
Restoring straightness supplies active stabilization rather than passive waiting.
Protected stored wealth identifies what the retaining structure keeps from premature exposure.
Arrival at a goal supplies the future point until which the wall must hold.
Reaching maturity supplies the developmental threshold preserved by the delay.
Extraction from concealment supplies the eventual release that successful holding enables.

changed_reading.before: Patience is only an inward capacity to endure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, patience is wall-like holding work: stabilize a threatened boundary so a concealed good is not exposed before its proper maturity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because صابر in ordinary focus syntax names patience, not legal surety. It remains anchored in ص ب ر B003 and gains functional support when continued companionship becomes conditional and then ends. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary relational activation: the learner's promise behaves like self-guarantee for staying with the guide.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صابرًا through ص ب ر B003, bearing guarantee and continuing attachment.

activation_trace.role: Guarantee and continuing attachment turn the patience claim into exploratory self-surety for the relationship.
Companionship and continued adherence identify the relation secured by the pledge.
Reaching the limit marks when the guide has received sufficient warrant to end the arrangement.
Excuse supplies the learner's acknowledgment that the guide will be released from further forbearance.
Separation realizes the relational consequence once the self-guarantee is exhausted.

changed_reading.before: I claim the trait of patience.
changed_reading.after: I provisionally stand surety for my own capacity to remain attached to your discipline; repeated breach exhausts that surety and releases you from companionship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and lexically unsafe as a direct rendering because it activates the coercive ص ب ر branch of holding a living being for killing. It remains rooted in the focus lexeme and is sharply activated by the later killing of a نفس, making the demanded restraint morally charged rather than placid. Downstream prose should retain it only as a dark branch-shadow, never as the primary sense of صابرا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صابرًا through the remote ص ب ر B002 image of coercive detention for killing.

activation_trace.role: Coercive holding for death casts a dark branch-shadow over what remaining restrained may force the witness to endure.
Taking life activates the otherwise distant killing-side image in the focus root inventory.
The living self specifies the morally irreducible object whose death makes restraint intolerable.

changed_reading.before: Patience is calm endurance under puzzling conduct.
changed_reading.after: At the branch-shadow level, the promise exposes the learner to the unbearable possibility that restraint may mean remaining held in witness while a living self is killed.

strongest_changes: The pledge becomes an observable, divinely contingent forecast rather than a self-certified trait.
Adjacent clauses define patience as delayed inquiry under incomplete access to an event's interior.
Repeated أمر shifts from directive to shocking affair to denied self-origin, putting obedience under semantic and agency pressure.
The episodes turn the forecast into a falsifiable companionship threshold whose meaning arrives only at outcome.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates finding, willing, restraint, rebellion, and أمر in one compact pledge. Context then tests every part: finding becomes enacted disclosure, restraint becomes an epistemic timing rule, أمر changes branch under pressure, and will is distributed across learner, guide, plural agency, and Lord. The wall also activates an unusually coherent material image of patience as preservation by holding.
remaining_uncertainties: The أمر sequence may be deliberate semantic pressure or ordinary contextual polysemy.
The no-question rule may define patience here or remain a separate condition of following.
The wall and killing activations are visibly anchored but branch-distant and should remain qualified rather than govern a final rendering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Conditioned future speech is correct yet not self-fulfilling.** `ش ي ء` B001’s “willing” variant conditions Moses’ promise, obeying 18:23–24, while `ص ب ر` B001 names the desired restraint. His later objections show that proper qualification does not itself produce capacity. I infer that acknowledging divine will prevents presumptuous closure but does not replace training. The ayah preserves sincerity alongside coming failure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The coming failures showed that invoking divine will preserves humility but cannot substitute for habituated restraint.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A future promise converted into a repeated obedience test.** `ع ص ي/B001` is leaving obedience to a commander. The fixed future `سَتَجِدُنِي` is conditioned by divine willing; 18:70 states the no-question rule, then 18:71–74 presents two shocks, two objections, and an intervening reminder. I infer that non-disobedience is not established by sincere declaration but found across successive triggers. `وَلَا أَعْصِي` reads as a prospective claim awaiting empirical exposure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:70’s rule and the two objections in 18:71–74 turned the future obedience claim into an observable sequence rather than a self-description.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قال يقول قولا، والقول والقيل، والكلام المركب من الحروف إذا أبرز بالنطق، مفردا كان أو جملة أو قصيدة أو خطبة.
يدخل فيه المقول بمعنى اللسان.
يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.
يدخل فيه القول بمعنى الاعتقاد، نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة.
يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.
يدخل فيه استعمال المنطقيين القول بمعنى الحد، كقول الجوهر وقول العرض أي حدهما.
يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.

root_profile.summary: Kök, azlık; bir şeyin tepesi veya başı; büyük bir kap; yük taşıma, yükselme ve yola koyulma; korku ya da öfkeden titreme; nesnenin oynayıp yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesi olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam kolunda düzenlenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi bulup ona erişmeyi, yitiği bulmayı ve bir şeyi duyularla ya da akılla algılamayı açıkça aynı dalda toplar. Bu nedenle dal çerçevesi kaynak kapsamını doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim bulma ve erişme çekirdeğini taşır; yitiği bulma, aranana erişme ve görme gibi okumalar yalnız kanıtlandıkları yapılara bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Aranan ya da karşılaşılan bir şeyi bulup ona erişmek; kaynakta belirtilen kullanımlarda ise onu duyularla veya akılla algılamaktır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi, özellikle arananı veya yitiği, bulmak ve ona erişmek.
Bir şeyi beş duyudan biriyle ya da akılla algılamak; belirli bağlamda görerek saptamak.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bulma ve erişme çekirdeğini destekler; toplu ifade ayrıca duyusal ve zihinsel algılamayı, belirli bir kullanımda da görmeyi bu dala bağlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Algılayan veya arayan bir katılımcının bir şeye ulaşmasını gerektirir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الشيء يلفيه (maqayis)؛ وجدت الضالة وجدانا (maqayis;sihah)؛ الوجدان والجدة من قولك وجدت الشيء أي أصبته (ayn)؛ وجدت الشيء أجده وجدانا (jamhara)؛ وجد مطلوبه يجده وجودا (sihah)؛ الوجود أضرب: وجود بإحدى الحواس الخمس ... ووجود بالعقل (mufradat)؛ حيث وجدتموهم أي حيث رأيتموهم (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كون الشيء موجودا أو موجودا بعد عدم، والتعبير عن الموجودات، وما أوجده الله.
يدخل فيه الجدة والوجد والوجدان في المال، والواجد بمعنى الغني، والتمكن والقدرة والسعة، وما جاء بصيغة الإغناء أو التقوية.
يدخل فيه الوجد بمعنى الحزن أو الحب، والتوجد لفلان بمعنى الحزن له، وما نص عليه المصدر من وجد الشهوة أو الوجدان العاطفي.
يدخل فيه وجد في الغضب، والموجدة من الغضب أو على الرجل، والوجدان إذا نص المصدر أنه في الغضب.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı, kişinin sarsıntı ve yakınma karşısında kendini tutması, aklın ve doğru sayılan davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kalması olarak kurar. Bu yüzden ruhsal dayanma ile zorla alıkoyma, öldürme, güvence verme ve somut nesne adları birbirinden ayrılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca genel özdenetim ve dayanma çekirdeğini verir, kalıba bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Sarsıntı, sıkıntı ya da istenmeyen bir durum karşısında kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyması ve doğru bildiği tutumu kararlılıkla sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Kişi, sarsıntı ve yakınma dürtüsüne karşı kendini tutar.
Bu kendini tutma, aklın ve doğru davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kararlı kalmayı içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı sarsıntının karşıtı olan, kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyup gereken tutumda kalmasını sağlayan bir özdenetim olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tepkiyi denetleyip doğru görülen tutumu sürdürme çekirdeğinin tamamı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kendini tutmayı hem de güçlük karşısında kararlı kalmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntı veya yıkım karşısında taşkın tepki vermeden dirençli kalmayı anlatan bağlamlarda doğaldır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ortak çekirdeği dışarıdan uygulanan zorlama ve alıkoyma olarak verir; bunun ölüm gerçekleşene kadar tutma ve yönetici önünde ant içmeye zorlama biçimleri vardır. Bu çerçeve içsel dayanma anlamından ve ödeşme cezasının bağımsız hukuki amacından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; genel zorla tutma ile öldürme ve ant içirme kalıpları ayrı yüzlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlıyı kaçamayacağı biçimde zorla tutmak; özel kullanımlarda onu öldürülene kadar bağlı bırakmak ya da yetkili önünde ant içmeye zorlamaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da canlı dışarıdan uygulanan güçle alıkonur ve çıkışı engellenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin üst bölümünü ya da yan sınırını, kap ve mezar gibi nesnelerin çevre yanlarını açıkça birlikte verir. Dolma anlatımı bu yan ya da üst sınıra kadar ulaşmayı bildirir; taş ve çakıllı arazi anlamları bu mekânsal parçadan ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; genel üst ve yan bölüm çekirdeği, kap ve mezar özelleşmeleri ile sınıra kadar dolma kalıbından ayrılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin üstünü veya yanını, kap ve mezarın çevre yanlarını ve doluluğun bu sınıra ulaşmasını aynı mekânsal bölüm çevresinde toplar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أم صبار وأم صبور للداهية، والحرب، والأمر العظيم أو الشديد الذي لا منفذ منه.
يدخل فيه صبارة الشتاء وصنابر الشتاء بمعنى شدة برده.
يدخل فيه الصبر بكسر الباء: عصارة شجرة أو دواء مر.
يدخل فيه الصبار بضم الصاد، حمل شجرة حامض له عجم أحمر عريض يسمى التمر الهندي.
يدخل فيه الصبر أو الصبير للسحاب الأبيض أو السحاب المستوي فوق الكثيف، والسحاب الذي يصبر بعضه فوق بعض درجا.
يدخل فيه صبير الخوان الرقاقة العريضة تحت الطعام، والصبرة من الطعام إذا كان بعضه فوق بعض أو بيع بلا كيل ووزن.
يدخل فيه اصطبر بمعنى اقتص، وأصبره السلطان إذا أقصه أو قتله بقود.
يدخل فيه تفسير ما أصبرهم على النار بمعنى ما أجرأهم أو ما أعملهم بعمل أهل النار، وهو استعمال تعجبي لا صبر حقيقي.
يدخل فيه التعبير عن الانتظار بالصبر، مثل فاصبر لحكم ربك أي انتظر حكمه.
يدخل فيه تسمية الصوم صبرا وشهر الصبر لكون الصوم نوعا من الصبر.
يدخل فيه الصبر اسما لبطن من غسان.
يدخل فيه الصبير بمعنى الجبل، والصبير الأقدر وهو الوسط من الجبال.
يدخل فيه الصبار بمعنى صمام القارورة أو السداد الذي يسد به رأس الحوجلة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyişinin ortak çekirdeği, bir kimsenin kendisine buyruk verenin sözünü tutmaması ve ondan beklenen boyun eğme çizgisinden çıkmasıdır. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bunu doğru yansıtır; bir topluluğun yöneticisinin sözünden çıkması bu çekirdeğin özel bir görünümüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dalın çekirdeği tek başına kullanılan karşı gelme biçimlerini kapsar; topluluğu bölme ve birliğin dağılması anlamları yalnız belirli söz öbeklerine bağlı yan kullanımlardır ve çekirdeğe katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin, sözünü dinlemesi gereken birinin buyruğunu tutmayarak ona karşı gelmesi ve boyun eğme çizgisinden çıkmasıdır. Topluluğun birliğini bozma ya da birliğin dağılması anlamları yalnız belirli söz öbeklerine bağlıdır ve bu çekirdeği genişletmez.

facets.statement: Bir kimse, buyruğuna uyması gereken kişinin sözünü tutmaz, ona karşı gelir ve beklenen boyun eğmeden çıkar.
Topluluğun birliğini bozma veya birliğin dağılması, yalnız belirli söz öbeklerinde görülen bağımlı kullanımlardır; çıplak dalın anlamı değildir.

Tahdhib, yöneticisine karşı davranan kişi ve Rabbine karşı gelen kul örneklerini bu çekirdeğin özel katılımcıları olarak verir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür bare olduğu için tanım yalnız çıplak biçimin durum, hal ve konu anlamını verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, topluluğun veya durumun konusu, hali ya da ele alınan tekil işi.

facets.statement: Anlamın çekirdeği, insan işleri arasında tek tek sayılabilen konu, hal veya durumdur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı ortak biçimde bir konu, hal ya da tekil iş anlamı olarak verir; çoğul kullanım da aynı alanın çoklu hallerini anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çıplak biçim bir olayın, kişinin veya topluluğun ele alınan durumu ya da işi olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tekil konu, hal ve durum çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya şeyin içinde bulunduğu hali anlatan bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hal ve vaziyet yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tekil konu veya iş olma yönünü her bağlamda açık taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin ele alınan meselesi veya yürüyen konusu kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ele alınan tekil konu yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Hal ve genel durum genişliğini daraltır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir durumun veya konunun kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Birine bir eylemi yapmasını bildiren bağlayıcı isteği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de insan işleri ve yapılacak şeyler alanında karışabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ele alınan şeyin ne olduğunu söyler; komşu dal ise birinin başka birine yönelttiği yapma yükümlülüğünü anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Konu veya hal olarak kalan tekil işi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yönetme yetkisini, yöneticiyi veya birini yönetici yapmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir iş üzerinde yetki veya düzen fikriyle birlikte geçebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yetki sahibi kişiyi değil, söz konusu edilen hali veya işi adlandırır; komşu dalda ise makam ve yönetme yetkisi çekirdektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ele alınan durum veya konudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi tanıtan belirti, yol işareti ya da belirlenmiş zamandır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir konuya ait tanıtıcı işaretler aynı söylemde bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal işaret edilen konunun kendisine gider; komşu dal ise tanıtmaya veya zamanı göstermeye yarayan belirtiyi anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı sınır için gözden geçirildi; yalnız aynı kökten okuyucu karışıklığı doğuran yakın alanlar yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمر بمعنى الشأن والحال والقضية العامة، وواحد الأمور، وما يرجع إلى جهة ما من شأن.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمر من الأمور، الواحد من الأمور (maqayis)؛ الأمر واحد من أمور الناس (ayn)؛ الأمر واحد الأمور (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الأمر الشأن وجمعه أمور (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı yasaklamanın karşıtı olan yapma isteği, yükümlü kılma ve bu isteğin söz kalıbı olarak tanımlar. Geçici çerçeve çıplak ve yapı içi kullanımları birlikte tutar, fakat anlamı genel konuya veya yöneticiliğe genişletmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür mixed_non_bare olduğu için çıplak buyruk anlamı ile özel kalıp kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Birine belirli bir eylemi yapmasını bildiren ve onu o eylemle yükümlü kılan söz ya da isteme eylemi.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, yasaklamanın karşıtı olan yapma isteği ve yükümlü kılmadır.
Bazı biçimler bu isteğin söz dizisindeki kullanımını veya bir kez uyulacak özel yükümlülüğü gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu anlamı yasaklamanın karşıtı olan eylem buyurma ve birini bir şeyi yapmakla yükümlü kılma alanında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişiye belirli bir eylemi yapması yönünde bağlayıcı söz yöneltildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma isteği, muhatap ve yükümlülük çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz veya karar olarak eylem yapma yükümlülüğü bildirildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma isteği ve bağlayıcı söz yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil olarak bir muhataptan belirli bir işi yapması isteniyorsa uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Muhataba yönelen yapma isteğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yükümlülüğün resmi veya bağlayıcı gücünü zayıflatabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onlara uymaları buyruldu, onlar da karşı geldi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir eylemi yaptıran söz ve yükümlülük vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaptırma sözü olmadan konu, hal veya iş adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir iş veya mesele çevresinde kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir muhataba yöneltilen yapma yükümlülüğünü anlatır; komşu dalda ise böyle bir isteme ilişkisi bulunmadan konunun kendisi anlatılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözle eylem yükümlülüğü getirme çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Makam, yönetici ve yönetme yetkisi çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yönetici buyruk verebilir, fakat iki dal aynı anlam değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal söylenen yapma yükümlülüğünü tanımlar; komşu dal bu yükümlülüğü verme yetkisine sahip makam veya kişiye odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir muhataba eylem yapma yükümlülüğü bildirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir iş hakkında görüş alışverişi yapıp görüşe varma süreci anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir iş hakkında söz söyleme ve yön verme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal muhataba bağlayıcı yapma isteği yöneltir; komşu dal ise görüş alma, tartma ve karar oluşturma sürecidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlananlar buyruk anlamını konu, makam ve yükleme alanlarından ayıran en gerekli sınırlar oldu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمر المضاد للنهي، والتكليف بالفعل، وصيغ الطلب مثل مر وأمر، وامتثال الأمر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمر الذي هو نقيض النهي قولك افعل كذا (maqayis)؛ الأمر نقيض النهي وإذا أمرت من الأمر قلت اؤمر (ayn)؛ أمرته بكذا أمرا والجمع الأوامر (sihah)؛ الأمر معروف نقيض النهي (tahdhib)؛ مصدر أمرته إذا كلفته أن يفعل شيئا، والتقدم بالشيء (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإمرة والإمارة والولاية، والأمير والمؤمر، وتولية شخص أميرا أو تسلطه.
يدخل فيه الكثرة والنماء والبركة واليمن، وكثرة المال أو القوم أو النسل.
يدخل فيه الأمارة والأمار بمعنى العلامة، وأعلام الطريق أو المفازة، والموعد أو الوقت المضروب.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şaşırtıcı, ağır, büyük ve yadırganan işi anlatır; bazı açıklamalar bunu büyük kötülük veya tuhaflık olarak açar. Geçici çerçeve bu şiddetli yadırganma çekirdeğini doğru verir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür mixed_non_bare olduğu için ad biçimi ile özel niteleme kalıbı aynı çekirdeğe bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Büyüklüğü, şiddeti veya aykırılığı yüzünden şaşırtıcı ve yadırganan ağır iş ya da olay.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, büyük ve şiddetli oluşuyla yadırganan olaydır.
Kaynak açıklamalarında şaşırtıcılık, ağır kötülük ve aykırılık tonları aynı çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı büyük, şiddetli ve yadırganan bir şey olarak birleştirir; açıklamalar şaşırtıcılık ile ağır kötülük tonları arasında değişir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir olay büyüklüğü veya aykırılığı sebebiyle şaşırtıcı ve kınanır nitelikte olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyüklük, şiddet ve yadırganma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olayın büyüklüğü ve ağırlığı vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyüklük ve ağırlığı korur.
error_profile.loses: Yadırganma veya kötülük tonunu her zaman açık taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aykırılık ve kınanma tonu önde olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yadırganma ve aykırılık yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şiddetli yadırganma ve büyük kötülük tonu birlikte bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda yapılmış, uydurulmuş veya şaşırtıcı şey tonu daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de büyük ve şaşırtıcı olay alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ağır ve kınanır oluşu öne çıkarır; komşu dal şaşırtıcı veya yapılmış şey niteliğine daha çok açılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ağır ve yadırganan tek olay ya da iş anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Daha çok bela, çözülmesi güç ağır sıkıntı veya dehşetli durum alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de büyük, kötü ve sarsıcı olay alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayın yadırganan büyüklüğünü adlandırır; komşu dal felaket veya çıkmaz niteliğini daha güçlü taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Büyük ve şaşırtıcı aykırılık çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel kötülük ve iyi olanın karşıtı çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kınanan veya kötü görülen olaylarda birlikte düşünülebilirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal her kötülüğü değil, büyüklüğü ve aykırılığıyla sarsıcı olan şeyi anlatır; komşu dal genel kötü ve zararlı olan alandır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü ağır olay, bela ve kötülük alanlarına göre elendi; en açıklayıcı üç sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإمر بمعنى العجب أو الأمر الشديد الكبير والمنكر العظيم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العجب، لقد جئت شيئا إمرا (maqayis)؛ أمر أمره أي اشتد والاسم الإمر، ويقال عجبا (sihah)؛ لقد جئت شيئا إمرا أي جئت شيئا عظيما من المنكر (tahdhib)؛ إمرا أي منكرا، من قولهم أمر الأمر أي كبر وكثر (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المؤامرة والائتمار والاستئمار والتآمر، أي مشاورة النفس أو الغير، وقبول الرأي أو العزم عليه.
يدخل فيه الإمر أو الإمرة للرجل الضعيف الرأي أو الأحمق الذي يستأمر كل أحد ويأتمر لكل أمر.
يدخل فيه الإمر لولد الضأن أو الخروف، والإمرة للأنثى أو الرخل.
يدخل فيه الأمر بمعنى الإبداع والإنشاء المختص بالله، والتعبير عن سرعة الإيجاد بالقول.
يدخل فيه السنان المؤمر أي المحدد، وأمر القناة بمعنى جعل سنان فيها.
